ignoreValues.reason: Email clients strip @font-face; a web-safe stack is the only face that reliably renders. Asgrike was attempted via images and failed in a real inbox three times, so Arial is the documented fallback, not a default reach.

Remaining sub-11px values are not readable text: font-size:1px on the display:none inbox-preheader, and font-size:0 on four spacer cells whose only content is   (the standard email trick to stop a spacer gaining height). The one real instance, 10.5px footer links on mobile, was fixed to 11px.
